title: test(plugin-auth): scope the SSO-bridge posture stamp to the then-installed 1.7.1
body:
Fixes #14020

## What this changes

One string, in one test title:

```
packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-sso-bridge-gate.test.ts:271

-  it('measured vendor posture (installed 1.7.1): an org-less /sso/register admits any authenticated user', ...
+  it('measured vendor posture (then-installed 1.7.1): an org-less /sso/register admits any authenticated user', ...
```

Nothing else in the file, and nothing else in the repo. No changeset file — see the route note at the bottom.

## Why it was false, not merely stale

`installed 1.7.1` is a present-tense claim about **this tree**. On `origin/main` the tree says otherwise:

```
packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json
  27:    "@better-auth/core": "^1.7.2",
  28:    "@better-auth/oauth-provider": "^1.7.2",
  29:    "@better-auth/scim": "^1.7.2",
  30:    "@better-auth/sso": "^1.7.2",
  37:    "better-auth": "^1.7.2",

pnpm-lock.yaml
  better-auth@1.7.2
```

So the sentence asserted something about the installed version that the lockfile contradicts. `then-installed` is the scoping vocabulary `scripts/check-vendor-version-stamps.mjs` prescribes for exactly this repair — it is in that script's `HISTORICAL_SCOPE_MARKERS`, and its remedy (b) names the spelling outright:

```
(b) keep 1.7.1 and SCOPE the sentence to when it was true — the
    cheapest honest repair, and it re-measures nothing. ... or write
    "the then-installed 1.7.1" where it now says "the installed 1.7.1"
```

It is also the spelling already used across this package (`auth-plugin.ts`, `auth-manager.ts`, `organization-add-member.ts`, `vendor-admin-refusal-envelope.ts`, and others). The **attestation is unchanged**: the posture was measured against 1.7.1, and that stays true at every future bump. No measurement was redone and no version number was restamped — restamping without re-measuring is the false-attestation shape that gate exists to prevent.

## ⛔ What this does NOT do — read this before reading the numbers below

This PR rewrites **one false sentence into a true one**. It does **not** repair the class.

The detector still cannot see this class of stamp. The site is unattributed — a family name is inside the window but sits in a different paragraph of the comment block, separated by a bare decoration-only line, and after PR #14017 a name reaches to the end of its sentence and no further. That is the attribution rule working as designed. Before this change the site was counted and never judged; after this change it is **still** counted and still never judged. If the same shape is written again tomorrow, nothing goes red.

⛔ The attribution rules in `scripts/check-vendor-version-stamps.mjs` are **not touched here**, deliberately: block-level attribution with a uniqueness condition (option 2 on the card) is a measured design change needing the same before/after sweep over both populations with the CONTESTED column at zero. It remains an open design question, and it is deliberately not filed as a fix by this PR.

## Detector before/after — proving it was not touched, and that its counts moved only as expected

All readouts below are from commit `7f4987fe7`, running the detector unmodified.

**The gate itself — byte-identical before and after:**

```
check:vendor-version-stamps: OK — 6053 file(s) scanned.
  better-auth: 250 version stamp(s); resolved 1.7.2; 138 name(s) a different version, reported and not enforced.
```

**`--census` — byte-identical before and after** (it lists judged sites, and this site is unattributed, so it never appears there).

**`--list` — exactly one line changes, and its verdict does not:**

```
before:
  [unattributed] packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-sso-bridge-gate.test.ts:271  (unattributed)@1.7.1  it('measured vendor posture (installed 1.7.1): an org-less /sso/register admits any auth

after:
  [unattributed] packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-sso-bridge-gate.test.ts:271  (unattributed)@1.7.1  it('measured vendor posture (then-installed 1.7.1): an org-less /sso/register admits any
```

Still `[unattributed]`. Whole-population verdict counts are unchanged in both directions: 250 sites = 2 current + 3 fixture + 138 historical + 107 unattributed, before and after.

**`--attribution-sweep` — exactly one cell moves, and it is the counterfactual mechanism, not the shipped one:**

```
                            before                                  after
  legacy char-gap 400   :  250 site(s), 173 attributed, 12 contested, 2 failing   ->   1 failing
  (every other row byte-identical, including all four sentence rows)
```

That is the honest confirmation the card asked for. The legacy character-window mechanism — the one PR #13981 rejected with numbers, and which this PR does not adopt — *would* have attributed this site and judged it `live-stale`. Probed directly through the gate's own exports:

```
BEFORE (HEAD blob of the file):
  FAILING@gap400  admin-sso-bridge-gate.test.ts:271  [live-stale]  pkg=better-auth  v=1.7.1
      it('measured vendor posture (installed 1.7.1): an org-less /sso/register admits any authenticated user', ...

AFTER (this branch):
  (this site is absent from the failing set)
```

So the defect was real under any mechanism that can see it; the substance is repaired even though the shipped mechanism's counts do not move.

The one gap-400 failure that **remains** is the card's own counter-example, unchanged by this PR and left alone on purpose:

```
FAILING@gap400  packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:3198  [live-stale]  pkg=better-auth  v=1.6.20
      // That bridge dates from 1.6.20, where @better-auth/sso hardcoded the
```

That is a permanently true historical sentence, red only because the character window reaches past a sentence boundary and picks up "installed" from the next sentence. A red whose only available repair turns a true sentence into a false one is worse than silence — which is why the reach is not widened here.

`--self-test`: 64 checks pass.

- Derived gate families for this diff (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 26 families, harvested with `--commands`): **25 green**. The 26th, `scripts/check-test-completeness.mjs`, exits 3 = `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` locally — it needs a saved `turbo run test` log and says so itself; recorded as NOT MEASURED, not as a pass and not as a red. CI supplies that log.

- `pnpm check:nul-bytes` and `node scripts/check-ratchet-remedy-authority.mjs` green. `check:declared-population-live` is not owed: no `scripts/**` path is touched.

## Changeset route

Route **2** of the Check Changeset step, the one it marks PREFERRED: *"It releases nothing (... tests-only ...) → apply the `skip-changeset` label."* This diff is a single test-title string, and `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` publishes `files: ["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]` — the test file never ships, so no package releases anything. The label is applied on this PR. Route 3, the empty-frontmatter changeset, is closed and was not taken.

## Not addressed here

- #13981 (docs root and prose-distance attribution) is a separate matter and stays as scoped.
- Block-level attribution with a uniqueness condition — option 2 on the card — is an open design question with its own measurement bar. Not attempted here, and no fix filed for it.
